text: The annual labour of every nation is the fund which originally supplies it with all the necessaries and conveniencies of life which it annually consumes, and which consist always either in the immediate produce of that labour, or in what is purchased with that produce from other nations.
chunks: The annual labour of every nation is the fund
which originally supplies it with all the necessaries
and conveniencies of life which it annually consumes,
and which consist always either in the immediate produce of that labour,
or in what is purchased with that produce from other nations.

text: In those great manufactures, on the contrary, which are destined to supply the great wants of the great body of the people, every different branch of the work employs so great a number of workmen, that it is impossible to collect them all into the same workhouse.
chunks: In those great manufactures, on the contrary, which are destined
to supply the great wants of the great body
of the people, every different branch of the work employs
so great a number of workmen,
that it is impossible to collect them all into the same workhouse.

text: The occasions for those different sorts of labour returning with the different seasons of the year, it is impossible that one man should be constantly employed in any one of them.
zh: 这些不同种类的劳动的场合随一年中的不同季节而变化，一个人不可能经常从事其中任何一种劳动。
chunks: The occasions for those different sorts
of labour returning with the different seasons
of the year, it is impossible
that one man should be constantly employed
in any one of them.

text: The rapidity with which some of the operations of those manufactures are performed, exceeds what the human hand could, by those who had never seen them, be supposed capable of acquiring.
zh: 对于那些从未见过它们的人来说，这些制造商执行某些操作的速度超出了人手所能达到的速度。
chunks: The rapidity with which some of the operations
of those manufactures are performed,
exceeds what the human hand could,
by those who had never seen them,
be supposed capable of acquiring.

text: One of the greatest improvements that has been made upon this machine, since it was first invented, was in this manner the discovery of a boy who wanted to save his own labour.
zh: 自首次发明以来，对这台机器所做的最伟大的改进之一就是以这种方式发现了一个想要节省自己劳动力的男孩。
chunks: One of the greatest improvements
that has been made upon this machine,
since it was first invented,
was in this manner the discovery
of a boy who wanted to save his own labour.

text: This, however, is not the effect of any contract, but of the accidental concurrence of their passions in the same object at that particular time.
zh: 然而，这并不是任何契约的效果，而是他们在特定时间对同一对象的热情偶然一致的结果。
chunks: This, however, is not the effect
of any contract,
but of the accidental concurrence
of their passions in the same object
at that particular time.

text: With the money which one man gives him he purchases food.
zh: 他用一个人给他的钱来购买食物。
chunks: With the money
which one man gives him he purchases food.

text: The strength of the mastiff is not in the least supported either by the swiftness of the greyhound, or by the sagacity of the spaniel, or by the docility of the shepherd’s dog.
zh: 獒犬的力量丝毫没有灵缇犬的敏捷、西班牙猎犬的聪明、牧羊犬的温顺所支撑。
chunks: The strength of the mastiff is not
in the least supported either
by the swiftness of the greyhound,
or by the sagacity of the spaniel,
or by the docility of the shepherd’s dog.

text: Upon two hundred tons of goods, therefore, carried by the cheapest land-carriage from London to Edinburgh, there must be charged the maintenance of a hundred men for three weeks, and both the maintenance and what is nearly equal to maintenance the wear and tear of four hundred horses, as well as of fifty great waggons.
chunks: Upon two hundred tons of goods, therefore,
carried by the cheapest land-carriage from London to Edinburgh,
there must be charged the maintenance of a hundred men for three weeks,
and both the maintenance and what is nearly equal to maintenance the wear and tear
of four hundred horses, as well as of fifty great waggons.

text: The navigation of the Danube is of very little use to the different states of Bavaria, Austria, and Hungary, in comparison of what it would be, if any of them possessed the whole of its course, till it falls into the Black sea.
zh: 多瑙河的航行对于巴伐利亚、奥地利和匈牙利这三个国家来说几乎没有什么用处，如果其中任何一个国家拥有整个多瑙河的航道，直到它流入黑海，那么它们的用处就很小了。
chunks: The navigation of the Danube is of very little use
to the different states of Bavaria, Austria, and Hungary, in comparison
of what it would be, if any
of them possessed the whole
of its course, till it falls into the Black sea.

text: Different metals have been made use of by different nations for this purpose.
zh: 不同的国家为此目的使用了不同的金属。
chunks: Different metals have been made use
of by different nations for this purpose.

text: The denominations of those coins seem originally to have expressed the weight or quantity of metal contained in them.
zh: 这些硬币的面额似乎最初表示了其中所含金属的重量或数量。
chunks: The denominations
of those coins seem originally
to have expressed the weight
or quantity of metal contained
in them.

text: All other debtors in the state were allowed the same privilege, and might pay with the same nominal sum of the new and debased coin whatever they had borrowed in the old.
zh: 该州的所有其他债务人都享有同样的特权，并且可以用新的和贬值的硬币的相同名义金额偿还他们在旧硬币中借入的任何东西。
chunks: All other debtors
in the state were allowed the same privilege,
and might pay with the same nominal sum
of the new and debased coin whatever they had borrowed
in the old.

text: What is bought with money, or with goods, is purchased by labour, as much as what we acquire by the toil of our own body.
zh: 用金钱或商品购买的东西，都是通过劳动购买的，就像我们通过自己的身体劳作获得的东西一样。
chunks: What is bought with money,
or with goods,
is purchased by labour, as much
as what we acquire by the toil
of our own body.

text: Every commodity, besides, is more frequently exchanged for, and thereby compared with, other commodities, than with labour.
zh: 此外，每一种商品都比劳动力更频繁地与其他商品进行交换，从而与其他商品进行比较。
chunks: Every commodity, besides,
is more frequently exchanged for,
and thereby compared with,
other commodities,
than with labour.

text: But though equal quantities of labour are always of equal value to the labourer, yet to the person who employs him they appear sometimes to be of greater, and sometimes of smaller value.
zh: 但是，尽管等量的劳动对劳动者来说总是具有同等的价值，但对雇用他的人来说，这些劳动的价值有时显得更大，有时则显得更小。
chunks: But though equal quantities of labour are always
of equal value to the labourer,
yet to the person
who employs him they appear sometimes
to be of greater, and sometimes of smaller value.

text: When the degradation in the value of silver is combined with the diminution of the quantity of it contained in the coin of the same denomination, the loss is frequently still greater.
zh: 当白银价值的贬值与相同面值的硬币中所含白银数量的减少相结合时，损失往往更大。
chunks: When the degradation in the value of silver is combined
with the diminution of the quantity
of it contained in the coin
of the same denomination,
the loss is frequently still greater.

text: But though, in establishing perpetual rents, or even in letting very long leases, it may be of use to distinguish between real and nominal price; it is of none in buying and selling, the more common and ordinary transactions of human life.
zh: 但是，在确定永久租金时，甚至在出租很长的租约时，区分实际价格和名义价格可能是有用的；它与人类生活中更常见和普通的交易——买卖无关。
chunks: But though, in establishing perpetual rents,
or even in letting very long leases,
it may be of use to distinguish between real and nominal price;
it is of none in buying and selling,
the more common and ordinary transactions of human life.

text: 3), when they first began to coin silver.
zh: 3），当他们第一次开始铸造银币时。
chunks: when they first began
to coin silver.

text: This difference, however, would be altogether owing to the custom of keeping accounts, and of expressing the amount of all great and small sums rather in silver than in gold money.
zh: 然而，这种差异完全是由于记账习惯以及用白银而不是金币来表示所有大小金额的习惯造成的。
chunks: This difference, however, would be altogether owing
to the custom of keeping accounts,
and of expressing the amount of all great
and small sums rather in silver
than in gold money.

text: Before the reformation of the gold coin, the price of standard gold bullion in the market had, for many years, been upwards of £3:18s. sometimes £ 3:19s, and very frequently £4 an ounce; that sum, it is probable, in the worn and degraded gold coin, seldom containing more than an ounce of standard gold.
chunks: Before the reformation of the gold coin, the price
of standard gold bullion in the market had, for many years,
been upwards of £3: 18s. sometimes £ 3: 19s,
and very frequently £4 an ounce; that sum, it is probable,
in the worn and degraded gold coin, seldom containing more than an ounce of standard gold.

text: There subsists at present a like permission of exporting gold bullion, and a like prohibition of exporting gold coin; and yet the price of gold bullion has fallen below the mint price.
zh: 目前存在类似的金条出口许可和金币出口类似的禁止；然而金条的价格已经跌破了铸币价格。
chunks: There subsists at present a like permission
of exporting gold bullion, and a like prohibition
of exporting gold coin; and yet the price
of gold bullion has fallen
below the mint price.

text: At home, it would buy more than that weight.
chunks: At home,
it would buy more
than that weight.

text: In the advanced state of society, allowances of this kind, for superior hardship and superior skill, are commonly made in the wages of labour; and something of the same kind must probably have taken place in its earliest and rudest period.
zh: 在先进的社会中，这种对艰苦程度和技能的补贴通常是在劳动工资中提供的。类似的事情很可能在最早、最原始的时期就发生过。
chunks: In the advanced state of society, allowances of this kind,
for superior hardship and superior skill,
are commonly made in the wages of labour; and something
of the same kind must probably have taken place
in its earliest and rudest period.

text: As soon as the land of any country has all become private property, the landlords, like all other men, love to reap where they never sowed, and demand a rent even for its natural produce.
zh: 一旦任何一个国家的土地全部成为私有制，地主就和所有其他人一样，喜欢在没有种过的地方收割，甚至对自然产物也索要租金。
chunks: As soon as the land
of any country has all become private property,
the landlords, like all other men,
love to reap where they never sowed,
and demand a rent even for its natural produce.

text: It is otherwise, at least through the greater part of Europe, in river fisheries.
zh: 至少在欧洲大部分地区，河流渔业的情况却并非如此。
chunks: It is otherwise,
at least
through the greater part
of Europe,
in river fisheries.

text: Common farmers seldom employ any overseer to direct the general operations of the farm.
zh: 普通农民很少雇用任何监督员来指导农场的一般运营。
chunks: Common farmers seldom employ any overseer
to direct the general operations of the farm.

text: As, while he is preparing and bringing the goods to market, he advances to his workmen their wages, or their subsistence; so he advances to himself, in the same manner, his own subsistence, which is generally suitable to the profit which he may reasonably expect from the sale of his goods.
chunks: As, while he is preparing and bringing the goods to market, he advances
to his workmen their wages, or their subsistence;
so he advances to himself, in the same manner, his own subsistence,
which is generally suitable to the profit
which he may reasonably expect from the sale of his goods.

text: The whole quantity upon hand can be disposed of for this price, and can not be disposed of for more.
zh: 现有的全部数量可以按此价格处理，并且不能以更多的价格处理。
chunks: The whole quantity
upon hand can be disposed
of for this price,
and can not be disposed
of for more.

text: In the other species of industry, the produce of equal quantities of labour being always the same, or very nearly the same, it can be more exactly suited to the effectual demand.
zh: 在其他类型的工业中，等量劳动的产品总是相同或非常接近相同，它可以更准确地适应有效需求。
chunks: In the other species
of industry, the produce of equal quantities
of labour being always the same,
or very nearly the same,
it can be more exactly suited to the effectual demand.

text: When, by an increase in the effectual demand, the market price of some particular commodity happens to rise a good deal above the natural price, those who employ their stocks in supplying that market, are generally careful to conceal this change.
chunks: When, by an increase in the effectual demand, the market price
of some particular commodity happens
to rise a good deal above the natural price,
those who employ their stocks
in supplying that market, are generally careful to conceal this change.

text: The exclusive privileges of corporations, statutes of apprenticeship, and all those laws which restrain in particular employments, the competition to a smaller number than might otherwise go into them, have the same tendency, though in a less degree.
chunks: The exclusive privileges of corporations,
statutes of apprenticeship, and all those laws
which restrain in particular employments, the competition to a smaller number
than might otherwise go into them,
have the same tendency, though in a less degree.

text: In the fourth and last place, I shall endeavour to shew what are the circumstances which regulate the rent of land, and which either raise or lower the real price of all the different substances which it produces.
zh: 第四点，也是最后一点，我将尽力说明调节地租以及提高或降低其生产的所有不同物质的实际价格的环境是什么。
chunks: In the fourth and last place, I shall endeavour
to shew what are the circumstances
which regulate the rent of land,
and which either raise or lower the real price
of all the different substances which it produces.

text: This profit makes a second deduction from the produce of the labour which is employed upon land.
zh: 这个利润是从土地上的劳动产品中第二次扣除的。
chunks: This profit makes a second deduction
from the produce of the labour which is employed upon land.

text: Masters are always and everywhere in a sort of tacit, but constant and uniform, combination, not to raise the wages of labour above their actual rate.
zh: 主人无论何时何地都以一种心照不宣、但持续一致的组合方式，不将劳动工资提高到高于其实际工资水平。
chunks: Masters are always and everywhere
in a sort of tacit, but constant
and uniform, combination,
not to raise the wages
of labour above their actual rate.

text: The scarcity of hands occasions a competition among masters, who bid against one another in order to get workmen, and thus voluntarily break through the natural combination of masters not to raise wages.
zh: 人手的稀缺，引发了师傅们之间的竞争，他们为了得到工人而互相竞价，从而自愿突破师傅们的自然组合，不提高工资。
chunks: The scarcity of hands occasions a competition
among masters, who bid against one another
in order to get workmen,
and thus voluntarily break through the natural combination
of masters not to raise wages.

text: But though North America is not yet so rich as England, it is much more thriving, and advancing with much greater rapidity to the further acquisition of riches.
zh: 尽管北美还没有英国那么富裕，但它却更加繁荣，并且以更快的速度前进以进一步获得财富。
chunks: But though North America is not
yet so rich as England,
it is much more thriving,
and advancing with much greater rapidity
to the further acquisition of riches.

text: Marco Polo, who visited it more than five hundred years ago, describes its cultivation, industry, and populousness, almost in the same terms in which they are described by travellers in the present times.
zh: 五百多年前，马可·波罗曾到访过这里，​​他描述这里的耕种、工业和人口，几乎与当今旅行者所描述的相同。
chunks: Marco Polo, who visited it more
than five hundred years ago,
describes its cultivation, industry, and populousness,
almost in the same terms in which they are described
by travellers in the present times.

text: Every year the demand for servants and labourers would, in all the different classes of employments, be less than it had been the year before.
zh: 每年，在所有不同类别的就业中，对仆人和劳工的需求都会比前一年减少。
chunks: Every year the demand
for servants and labourers would,
in all the different classes
of employments, be less
than it had been the year before.

text: These vary everywhere from year to year, frequently from month to month.
zh: 这些情况每年、甚至每个月都有所不同。
chunks: These vary everywhere
from year
to year,
frequently from month
to month.

text: If the labouring poor, therefore, can maintain their families in the one part of the united kingdom, they must be in affluence in the other.
zh: 因此，如果劳动穷人能够在联合王国的某一地区养家糊口，那么他们在另一地区也一定会富裕起来。
chunks: If the labouring poor, therefore,
can maintain their families in the one part
of the united kingdom,
they must be in affluence
in the other.

text: If they cannot earn this by their labour, they must make it up, he supposes, either by begging or stealing.
zh: 他认为，如果他们不能通过自己的劳动赚取这些钱，他们就必须通过乞讨或偷窃来弥补。
chunks: If they cannot earn this
by their labour,
they must make it up,
he supposes, either by begging
or stealing.

text: No society can surely be flourishing and happy, of which the far greater part of the members are poor and miserable.
zh: 如果社会的大部分成员都处于贫困和悲惨的境地，那么任何社会都不可能是繁荣和幸福的。
chunks: No society can surely be flourishing
and happy,
of which the far greater part
of the members are poor
and miserable.

text: The liberal reward of labour, by enabling them to provide better for their children, and consequently to bring up a greater number, naturally tends to widen and extend those limits.
zh: 慷慨的劳动报酬使他们能够为自己的孩子提供更好的生活，从而抚养更多的孩子，自然会扩大和扩大这些限制。
chunks: The liberal reward of labour,
by enabling them to provide better
for their children, and consequently
to bring up a greater number,
naturally tends to widen and extend those limits.

text: The progressive state is, in reality, the cheerful and the hearty state to all the different orders of the society; the stationary is dull; the declining melancholy.
zh: 进步的状态实际上是社会各阶层都欢欣鼓舞的状态；文具是沉闷的；逐渐减弱的忧郁。
chunks: The progressive state is, in reality, the cheerful
and the hearty state
to all the different orders
of the society; the stationary is dull;
the declining melancholy.

text: In cheap years it is pretended, workmen are generally more idle, and in dear times more industrious than ordinary.
zh: 人们假装在廉价的年份，工人通常比平常更闲，而在昂贵的年份则比平常更勤奋。
chunks: In cheap years it is pretended,
workmen are generally more idle,
and in dear times more industrious
than ordinary.

text: The one, in his separate independent state, is less liable to the temptations of bad company, which, in large manufactories, so frequently ruin the morals of the other.
zh: 一个人在其各自独立的国家中，不太容易受到不良同伴的诱惑，而在大型工厂中，不良同伴常常会破坏另一个人的道德。
chunks: The one, in his separate independent state,
is less liable to the temptations
of bad company, which, in large manufactories,
so frequently ruin the morals
of the other.

text: In a year of sudden and extraordinary plenty, there are funds in the hands of many of the employers of industry, sufficient to maintain and employ a greater number of industrious people than had been employed the year before; and this extraordinary number cannot always be had.
chunks: In a year of sudden and extraordinary plenty, there are funds
in the hands of many of the employers of industry, sufficient to maintain
and employ a greater number of industrious people
than had been employed the year before;
and this extraordinary number cannot always be had.

text: The increase of stock, which raises wages, tends to lower profit.
zh: 股票的增加会提高工资，但往往会降低利润。
chunks: The increase
of stock,
which raises wages,
tends to lower profit.

text: They seem to have followed, and not to have gone before, the market rate of interest, or the rate at which people of good credit usually borrowed.
chunks: They seem to have followed,
and not to have gone before,
the market rate of interest,
or the rate at which people
of good credit usually borrowed.

text: The legal rate of interest in France has not during the course of the present century, been always regulated by the market rate {See Denisart, Article Taux des Interests, tom. iii, p.13}.
zh: 在本世纪中，法国的法定利率并不总是由市场利率调节{参见Denisart，Article Taux des Interests，tom。 iii，第 13 页}。
chunks: The legal rate of interest
in France has not during the course
of the present century, been always regulated
by the market rate {See Denisart,
Article Taux des Interests, tom. iii, p.13}.

text: During the late war, the Dutch gained the whole carrying trade of France, of which they still retain a very large share.
zh: 在战争后期，荷兰人获得了法国的全部转口贸易，并且至今仍然保留着很大的份额。
chunks: During the late war,
the Dutch gained the whole carrying trade
of France,
of which they still retain a very large share.

text: Money, says the proverb, makes money.
zh: 俗话说，钱生钱。
chunks: Money,
says the proverb,
makes money.

text: As the profits which can afford such an interest must eat up almost the whole rent of the landlord, so such enormous usury must in its turn eat up the greater part of those profits.
zh: 正如能够支付这种利息的利润必然会几乎耗尽地主的全部租金一样，如此巨大的高利贷也必然会耗尽这些利润的大部分。
chunks: As the profits
which can afford such an interest must eat up almost the whole rent
of the landlord, so such enormous usury must
in its turn eat up the greater part
of those profits.

text: The high rate of interest among all Mahometan nations is accounted for by M.
zh: 所有伊斯兰教国家的高利率都是由 M. 造成的。
chunks: The high rate
of interest among all Mahometan nations is accounted for by M.

text: The stock is at the risk of the borrower, who, as it were, insures it to the lender; and four or five per cent. may, in the greater part of trades, be both a sufficient profit upon the risk of this insurance, and a sufficient recompence for the trouble of employing the stock.
chunks: The stock is at the risk of the borrower, who, as it were, insures it
to the lender; and four or five per cent. may,
in the greater part of trades, be both a sufficient profit
upon the risk of this insurance,
and a sufficient recompence for the trouble of employing the stock.

text: The particular consideration of those circumstances, and of that policy, will divide this Chapter into two parts.
zh: 对这些情况和政策的特别考虑，将本章分为两部分。
chunks: The particular consideration
of those circumstances,
and of that policy,
will divide this Chapter
into two parts.

text: The natural taste for those employments makes more people follow them, than can live comfortably by them; and the produce of their labour, in proportion to its quantity, comes always too cheap to market, to afford any thing but the most scanty subsistence to the labourers.
chunks: The natural taste for those employments makes more people follow them,
than can live comfortably by them; and the produce
of their labour, in proportion to its quantity,
comes always too cheap to market, to afford any thing
but the most scanty subsistence to the labourers.

text: In country labour, on the contrary, the labourer, while he is employed about the easier, learns the more difficult parts of his business, and his own labour maintains him through all the different stages of his employment.
zh: 相反，在乡村劳动中，劳动者在从事较容易的工作的同时，也学习了其工作中较困难的部分，并且他自己的劳动在其就业的所有不同阶段中维持着他。
chunks: In country labour, on the contrary, the labourer,
while he is employed about the easier,
learns the more difficult parts of his business,
and his own labour maintains him
through all the different stages of his employment.

text: No species of skilled labour, however, seems more easy to learn than that of masons and bricklayers.
chunks: No species
of skilled labour, however,
seems more easy
to learn than that
of masons and bricklayers.

text: Whether the stock is or is not constantly employed, depends, not upon the trade, but the trader.
zh: 股票是否经常被使用，并不取决于交易，而是取决于交易者。
chunks: Whether the stock is
or is not constantly employed, depends,
not upon the trade,
but the trader.

text: The lottery of the law, therefore, is very far from being a perfectly fair lottery; and that as well as many other liberal and honourable professions, is, in point of pecuniary gain, evidently under-recompensed.
zh: 因此，法律的彩票远非完全公平的彩票；它是一种公平的彩票。而且，与许多其他自由和​​光荣的职业一样，就金钱收益而言，显然报酬不足。
chunks: The lottery of the law, therefore, is very far
from being a perfectly fair lottery;
and that as well as many other liberal
and honourable professions, is,
in point of pecuniary gain, evidently under-recompensed.

text: That the chance of gain is naturally overvalued, we may learn from the universal success of lotteries.
zh: 我们可以从彩票的普遍成功中学到，获利的机会自然被高估了。
chunks: That the chance
of gain is naturally overvalued,
we may learn
